pieces.text:
–   The issuer listed the account number on the Mastercard Stand-in Account File with a
              “capture card” response for 180-calendar days or until card expiration (whichever is
              shorter).
              This requirement does not apply when one of the following occurred:
              –   The transaction was a Mainland China domestic transaction;
              –   The card was issued in the Latin America and the Caribbean region, and the

transaction did not occur at a CAT 2 device; or
              –   The card was issued under a BIN or BIN range assigned for Germany when the issuer’s
                 stand-in parameters are set to zero to decline all authorization attempts or are
                 managed through an alternate host.
